sentences.en: It's clear that our arguments don't overlap at all.
sentences.zh: 很明显，我们的论点完全不重叠。

sentences.en: How many times per day do a clock’s hands overlap?
sentences.zh: 一天中时钟的指针有多少次会交叠？

sentences.en: When inserting the budwood into the root stock make the cambium layer overlap.
sentences.zh: 将接穗插入砧木时，请确保形成层部分重叠。
